02 / Context

Product scope

Fragmented tools → one workflow

Bring SEO discovery and fixes into Liferay DXP.

Liferay DXP powers enterprise websites and portals.

  • Current workflow. Find an issue in an SEO tool, locate the page in the CMS, research a fix, then validate it.
  • Target workflow. Bring Discover → AI Fix → Apply into SEO Studio.
  • Design focus. Help users review the generated change before applying it to their website.

04 / Challenge

Trust hypotheses

What / why / control

How might we help users confidently apply AI-generated fixes?

  1. 01

    What changed?

    Seeing the difference may make a fix easier to evaluate.

  2. 02

    Why is it better?

    A clear rationale may help users judge the recommendation.

  3. 03

    Am I in control?

    Editing and recovery may make applying a fix feel safer.

Working hypotheses · To validate through research and testing

05 / Solution

Review interface

Comparison / rationale / control

Help users compare, understand, and apply each fix.

01

Show exactly what the AI changed.

Proposed interaction

  • Place the original and suggested content side by side.
  • Highlight the exact edits within the same field.
  • Keep the comparison visible before the user applies the fix.
02

Explain why the fix is recommended.

Proposed interaction

  • Connect the rationale to the specific SEO issue.
  • Place the explanation beside the proposed content.
  • Use plain language to help users judge whether the suggestion fits.
03

Let users edit, apply, and revert the fix.

Proposed interaction

  • Let users review and edit the suggestion before applying it.
  • Make Apply an explicit decision after review.
  • Show the applied state and provide a clear path to revert.

These design decisions address the three working hypotheses above. Their effect on user behavior still needs validation.
